status_vocabulary.verified_ingested: data retrieved, archived in data/raw with checksums, used by a pipeline
status_vocabulary.verified_reachable: endpoint confirmed reachable and relevant; not yet ingested
status_vocabulary.blocked_credential: requires a human-registered API key/account; do not bypass
status_vocabulary.unreachable: DNS/HTTP failure from the research environment on the probe date; retry later, may work from Indonesia
status_vocabulary.candidate: known institution/system; endpoint and terms not yet verified
status_vocabulary.secondary_crosscheck: non-official transcription used only to cross-check an official source

sources.title: Buku Indeks Risiko Bencana Indonesia (IRBI) Tahun 2024
sources.publication_date: 2024 edition (exact publication date to be read from the book's colophon)
sources.unit: skor indeks risiko (multi-hazard total; per-hazard scores, flood max 36)
sources.methodology_summary: Risk = f(hazard, vulnerability, capacity) per BNPB method; per-hazard and multi-hazard indices with classes RENDAH/SEDANG/TINGGI.
sources.license_or_terms: Official public publication; terms not stated in the PDF text parsed. TODO verify before release.
sources.credibility_notes: Linked from the official InaRISK IRBI page. A newer IRBI 2025 exists only as an online flipbook (no PDF/text tables found), so 2024 is the latest edition with extractable tables. An IRBI 2023 copy hosted on bpbd.dumaikota.go.id was also archived (unused).

sources.institution: BNPB — Pusat Data Informasi dan Komunikasi Kebencanaan (Pusdatinkom)
sources.title: Satu Data Bencana Indonesia, CKAN portal: 'Kompilasi Data Jumlah dan Dampak Kejadian Bencana 2024' (kab/kota tables)
sources.credibility_notes: DataStore API used; direct file downloads are Cloudflare-challenged (not bypassed). Yearly packages 2002-2023 link to Google Drive folders whose download endpoints are disallowed by robots.txt -> manual download needed (G-15). Kab/kota sum 1428 vs national row 1420 (G-16).

known_discrepancies.description: 2024 flood events: kab/kota sum 1,428 vs national row 1,420 (+8); all impact tables consistent with national rows
